verdict.rationale: LangSmith's own docs say users can automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations. Evaluators run automatically on production traces, with filters and sampling rates. Threshold-based alerts and LangSmith Engine's automatic issue detection also run in the background without manual work. missing for 10: detailed documentation of automation-rule triggers and actions, any evidence of time-based recurring schedules, independent or hands-on corroboration of background automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.
Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge. Apply filters and sampling rates to control costs.
LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
Automatically detect recurring issues in your traces, diagnose their root cause, and resolve them with LangSmith Engine.
